settingName: Caesar's pirate captivity and pursuit in the eastern Aegean around 75 BCE
settingDescription: A historically plausible eastern Mediterranean world with rocky Aegean islands, simple ancient harbors, timber sailing vessels, muted limestone settlements and early first-century BCE Roman and eastern Mediterranean clothing. Young Caesar must look like the same individual whenever he returns, but unrelated pirates, sailors and officials must be visibly individualized.
recurringPlaces: the same rocky Pharmacusa anchorage with a narrow beach and low scrub
the same simple pirate vessel with dark timber hull and pale square sail whenever it recurs
recurringCharacters: young Julius Caesar: early-adult Roman aristocrat, lean build, short dark wavy hair, clean-shaven face, narrow red-brown cloak over a cream tunic, no imperial crown or later-dictator iconography
pirate leader: older than Caesar, broader build, weathered angular face, short dark beard with gray strands, faded blue-green cloak, leather belt and simple curved utility knife
recurringProps: dark-timber pirate vessel with pale sail
travel chests and tied silver containers used for the ransom
timeWeatherLogic: Begin in clear to lightly hazy Mediterranean daylight, move through repeated day-and-evening captivity scenes without dramatic weather changes, then return to bright daylight for the pursuit and capture. Use time changes only where the narration implies passing days.
continuityRules: Young Caesar keeps the same face, hair, lean build and red-brown cloak whenever continuity allows the cloak to be visible.
The pirate leader remains visually distinct from Caesar and keeps the same beard, broad build and blue-green cloak.
Other pirates must not become clones; vary face shape, beard, hair, headwear, body build, clothing silhouette and posture.
Do not show Caribbean pirate symbols, tricorn hats, eyepatches, cannons or black skull flags.
Keep the Pharmacusa anchorage recognizable when Caesar later returns to capture the pirates.
Any execution image must remain non-graphic, distant and free of gore.
